description: For appliance repair, this completion sign-off form records diagnostic sequence, service-manual checks, parts, labor, customer authorization, food or property protection, and testing. Its supporting evidence includes fault codes, voltage or pressure readings, component condition, part numbers, photos, and post-repair cycle result.
